patterns.note: Sections alternate between a warm cream background and a deep forest green background, creating clear visual breaks and a strong brand identity.
Heavy reliance on a single, extremely bold, condensed, uppercase sans-serif font (Oswald) for all major headings and prominent text, creating a poster-like, impactful visual hierarchy.
A distinctive brand palette of deep forest green, warm cream, and a muted olive green is used consistently for backgrounds, text, and graphic elements.
The large, central hero logo/illustration dynamically shrinks and repositions to the top-left corner, transforming into a compact sticky header as the user scrolls down the page.
Content sections reveal with a subtle upward slide and fade-in effect as they enter the viewport during scrolling.
The 'Wall of Love' section features a dynamic, overlapping collage of lifestyle and food photography, breaking from standard grid layouts.

technique_notes: The hero section's main illustrative logo transforms into a sticky header by scaling down and translating its position to the top-left of the viewport, likely using GSAP for smooth animation triggered by scroll position.

New content sections are revealed as the user scrolls, appearing with a subtle upward translation and opacity fade-in, suggesting the use of a scroll-triggered animation library like GSAP ScrollTrigger or CSS keyframes for staggered reveals.
The site uses CSS keyframes for subtle decorative animations, such as the radiating lines around the 'MON RESTAURANT' icon in the dark green descriptive section.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, condensed, and extremely bold uppercase headings (~5-10x body text) create a strong, almost billboard-like presence, contrasted with a more standard-sized, readable sans-serif for body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently across all elements, including images, buttons, and section boundaries.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within text blocks, creating a comfortable reading experience. The hero section is particularly airy.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is the dynamic transformation of its large, illustrative hero logo into a compact, sticky header on scroll, combined with the bold, almost street-art aesthetic created by the oversized, condensed typography and unique color palette.
